data.narrative:
Netrasemi is a Series A semiconductor company founded by Jyothis Indirabhai, Deepa Geetha, and Sreejith Varma, having raised ₹107 Cr (~$13M) to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public semiconductor players (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private-stage peers in chips & semiconductors, including SambaNova Systems, Rebellions, and d-Matrix.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement to the $13M total raised proxy, implying a $26M valuation. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a $2.3B median valuation, with a range spanning $2.0B (d-Matrix) to $11.0B (SambaNova Systems). Public-comp anchoring using the 20.5x P/S median across semiconductor tickers is not applicable due to absence of disclosed revenue for the target.

The triangulated range is $22M to $2.7B, with a median of $1.2B. This wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Netrasemi's current technology maturity, IP strength, and addressable market position relative to outlier peer SambaNova. The stage-progression method produces a floor anchored to capital deployed, while peer medians reflect market valuations of functionally comparable Series A chip ventures. Revenue traction and product-market signals will be critical to narrowing this range and establishing credible positioning within the peer set.
